leadText: (Japanese: 目指せ！幻の大地！！ Aim for the !) is the fifth chapter of the Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Blazing Exploration Team manga.
plainText:
(Japanese: 目指せ！幻の大地！！ Aim for the !) is the fifth chapter of the Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Blazing Exploration Team manga.

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
Totodile and Honō reveal what happened to them to the Wigglytuff Guild and how to fix the time freezing.
Chatot takes Totodile and Honō to see Torkoal, who tells them about the Hidden Land.
With the information they received from Torkoal, Honō and Totodile encounter Lapras, who takes them to the Hidden Land.
Upon arriving at the Old Ruins, Dusknoir returns to stop the two from changing the future.
Grovyle returns with the Time Gears to help battle against Dusknoir.
Grovyle sacrifices himself to send Dusknoir back into the future, but not before telling Honō that if he fixes the future, they will disappear from existence.
Honō and Totodile go to the Temporal Tower.

===Debuts===

==Characters==
===Pokémon===
Honō
